stem: The reader can conclude that Conner had to train with a coach for the Nashville Kids Triathlon because he —

options.label: A
options.text: wanted to be one of the first people to finish the race

options.label: B
options.text: was told to do so by the officials in charge of the race

options.label: C
options.text: knew a sports magazine would write a story about him

options.label: D
options.text: had to be able to pull or push his brother long distances
